Reachable, and it still holds this pairing.
Unverified — reported by the other device
On your Mac, run “copypaste pair accept” and type this code.
Anyone who reads this code can pair with this device. It is shown once and cannot be copied.
Type the code your other device is showing, and the address it is listening on.
This device will forget the pairing immediately. The other device keeps its half until you unpair there too.
Save whatever is on the clipboard each time you open the app.
Shows a notification and keeps CopyPaste alive while it talks to a paired device.

Android does not let any app read the clipboard while another app is in front — this has been true since Android 10, and no permission changes it. CopyPaste saves what you copy when you open it, and when you share text into it from another app.
Your history is stored encrypted in CopyPaste\'s private storage, with a key held in this device\'s hardware keystore. It is not backed up, because a backup could not be decrypted on another device.
Shown while CopyPaste is talking to a paired device.
Ready to sync with your paired devices.
CopyPaste could not open your history
Your history could not be unlocked on this device. It is still stored, but this device\'s key no longer opens it.
This data was saved by an older version of CopyPaste. It is untouched, and CopyPaste 2 needs to start fresh.
That item is no longer here.
That item could not be read.
Your history could not be read or written. Try again.
That pairing code is not valid.
That address could not be reached. Expected something like 192.168.1.20:47654.
The other device did not accept this pairing code.
That device is no longer paired.
This device has never connected here, so there is no address to reach it at. Sync from the other device instead.
The other device did not respond.
The list of paired devices could not be updated.
Syncing clipboard history between devices is not available in this build. Pairing works; moving items does not yet.
This device\'s security key is gone — usually after restoring a backup onto new hardware, or changing the screen lock. Your old history cannot be unlocked.
CopyPaste\'s security key could not be read on this device.
